# Lacuna v0.5.0

Lacuna `v0.5.0` completes the advanced-inference milestone. It makes selection, strategy-family
multiplicity, dependent resampling, and null construction explicit evidence rather than hidden
post-backtest choices.

## Highlights

- Combinatorial purged K-fold with every `C(N, k)` split, interval purge, per-group embargo, and
  inspectable reconstructed paths.
- Exchangeability-aware unrestricted, within-date, within-group, block, and sign-flip permutation
  tests with deterministic streams and finite-corrected p-values.
- Sharpe standard error and confidence bounds, PSR, DSR, and minimum track-record length with all
  eligible trial Sharpes visible.
- True symmetric CSCV/PBO with every IS selection, OOS rank, relative rank, logit, and partition
  sensitivity result exposed.
- Joint stationary bootstrap that preserves serial and cross-strategy dependence.
- White Reality Check and Hansen SPA over a declared benchmark differential matrix, including
  Hansen's long-run variance kernel and lower, consistent, and upper p-values.
- Independent literal reference implementations, generated invariants, fixed-seed size/power and
  overfit simulations, eager/lazy Polars plus pandas/Arrow equivalence, and benchmark artifact v4.
- A frozen additive `0.5.x` public contract preserving supported `0.1.x` through `0.4.x` calls.

## Method boundaries

CPCV and CSCV/PBO are intentionally distinct. CPCV generates label-safe model-fitting splits and
path assignments; PBO evaluates selection behavior over synchronous, already-computed strategy
performance. Reality Check and SPA require one common benchmark and positive-is-better performance
differentials. None of these methods discovers unreported trials, chooses a defensible block length,
or proves deployment readiness.

## Compatibility and distribution

This release keeps `AnalysisResult.schema_version == "1"` and adds methods without removing earlier
APIs. It is distributed as checksummed GitHub Release artifacts because the `lacuna` name on PyPI
belongs to an unrelated project. The release workflow builds and smoke-tests CPython 3.11
stable-ABI wheels for Linux x86_64/aarch64, macOS arm64, and Windows x86_64, plus a source
distribution and provenance attestations.

The full implementation record is in the
[changelog](https://github.com/eyenoticeall/Lacuna/blob/v0.5.0/CHANGELOG.md). Exact equations,
assumptions, outputs, failure modes, simulations, and primary references are in the
[advanced-inference methodology](https://github.com/eyenoticeall/Lacuna/blob/v0.5.0/docs/methodology/advanced-inference.md).
